title: Simulate Pagination
statement: A mock API returns items in pages. Given total_items and page_size (space-separated on one line), simulate the pagination cursor: print the number of pages required, then for each page (1-indexed) print 'Page <n>: <count> items', where count is page_size on every page except possibly the last, which may have fewer items.
starter_code:
total, size = map(int, input().split())
# TODO: compute the number of pages and print the pagination breakdown
hints: Number of pages is ceil(total / size), which in integer math is (total + size - 1) // size
Track how many items remain and take min(size, remaining) for each page

test_cases.expected_output:
4
Page 1: 3 items
Page 2: 3 items
Page 3: 3 items
Page 4: 1 items

4
Page 1: 2 items
Page 2: 2 items
Page 3: 2 items
Page 4: 1 items
